treaty_name: Convention between Canada and the Republic of Poland for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (2012, with Protocol; modified by MLI)
eif_quote: Canada-Poland Tax Convention Act, 2013: "[Note: Convention and Protocol in force October 30, 2013, see Canada Gazette Part I, Volume 147, page 2725.]" | Treaty-accord: "Entry into Force 30 October 2013"
source_title: Canada-Poland Tax Convention Act, 2013 (S.C. 2013, c. 30), Schedules 1-2 - Convention and Protocol (Justice Laws consolidated text)

rates.quote: (a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company that holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital in the company paying the dividends; and [MLI art. 8(1): 365-day holding period, effective for WHT from 2020-01-01]
(b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

2 However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

rates.article: Article 12(2) (royalties other than those in Art. 12(3), e.g. trade marks, software, films/TV, equipment)
rates.quote: 2 However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

3 Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2: (a) copyright royalties and other like payments in respect of the production or reproduction of any literary, dramatic, musical or artistic work (but not including royalties in respect of motion picture films nor royalties in respect of works on film, videotape or other means of reproduction for use in connection with television broadcasting), and (b) royalties for the use of, or the right to use, any patent or for information concerning industrial, commercial or scientific experience (but not including any such royalty provided in connection with a rental or franchise agreement), arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State, may also be taxed in the first-mentioned State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: 1 Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude; having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement. [Canada notified Art. 10(6), 11(8), 12(8) of the Poland Convention as existing provisions described in MLI Art. 7(2)]

notes: Art. 27(2)(b)(i): effective in Canada for tax withheld at source on amounts paid or credited on or after 1 January of the year following entry into force (EIF 2013-10-30 -> 2014-01-01); in Poland for income derived on or after that date. Replaced the 1987 Convention. Dividend 5% tier: company that holds directly at least 10% of the capital. MLI art. 8 365-day holding applies to Art. 10(2)(a): Canada notified "61 Poland Article 10(2)(a)", Poland notified "35 Canada Article 10(2)(a)"; effective for WHT from 2020-01-01 (before then no holding period). Royalty Art. 12(3): 5% cap for copyright (excluding films/TV) and patents/know-how (excluding rental/franchise); 10% for other royalties. Not modelled: Art. 11(3) exemptions (EDC / Polish State export-financing loans; unrelated credit sales). Art. 26(3) excludes low-taxed non-resident-owned entities.
